ANALYSIS OF THE PROBLEM:

Cheif complaints 

  • Chest pain since 2 months
  • Palpitation since 2 montha
  • Dyspnea
  • Bilateral pedal edema extending till ankle
  • Decreased urine output

       Chest pain

           # towards left
           # more in epigastric region
           #non radiating 

1.CHEST PAIN: lets see the causes




as per the chief complaints we get to know that the chest can be of cardiac or respiratory since there are plapitations and pedal edema
CAUSES EXCLUDED:
1.vascular; as there no other symptoms suggestive
 
                                          


2.neural causes: no evidence of neurological deficit and herpes infestation manifestations

 
                                                     

3.musculoskeletal and gastrointestinal :since no symptoms suggestive of muscle pain , tenderness, joint pains and bowel abnormalities

2.PALPITATIONS


  • pulse is feeble ireerugularly irregular rhythm
  • ECG
Irregular rythm P wave absent  indicating atrial 

Right axisis deviation indicating enlarged heart
St elevation in v4 v5 aVR
        Jvp was raised and showed prominent a wave 







3.DECREASED URINE OUTPUT:




IN THIS CASE THIS WOULD BE HYPOVOLEMIA



BUT LETS CHECK AND CORRELATE WITH INVESTIGATIONS.



AUSCULTATION FINDINGS:

                                Mitral area: Loud S1 heard

                                Tricuspid area: Loud S1 heard

                                Pulmonary area: Splitting of S2-loud P2 component

                -On X-ray imaging: Cardiomegaly - Enlargement of Rt. Atrium, Rt. Ventricle, Lt. Ventricle


                           


  -In 2D echo, Mitral valves calcification and fish mouth appearance was see


REFER:https://himabindu5.blogspot.com/2020/05/hello-everyone.html




BASED ON ALL THE ABOVE FINDINGS AND COMPLAINTS 
PROVISIONAL DIAGNOSIS OF MITRAL STENOSIS WAS MADE.

TREATMENT:
1.INJ.LASIX 2amp in 50ml NS @8mg/hr
2.oxygenation to maintain spO2 above 95%
3.nebulization with budecort 12th hourly
4.strict I/O charting
5.monitoring BP,PR hourly
6.fluid and salt restriction
7.head end elevation
8.inj.amiodarone 300mg (2amp) at 6ml/hr
9.inj.pantop 40mg/OD/iv
10.T. ecosprin 75mg/PO/OD
